vocabulary, plus one near-miss substring that shares a letter-prefix with an
allowlist term without ever forming a whole-word match on its own
(`argonaut` extends past that allowlist term's own four letters, so no word
boundary exists at the point where they would otherwise coincide) -- proves
the whole-word scan does not over-match a mere shared substring.
